fields.label: Address
fields.help: The IP or host name of the Pocket WiFi or Pocket LAN dongle on the network, with :port when it is not 80.
fields.patternMessage: An IP or host name, with :port when it is not 80 - no http:// and no path.

fields.label: Username
fields.help: Only when the dongle's web page asks for a username as well - usually admin. Leave empty otherwise.

fields.label: Password
fields.help: The password of the dongle's own web page: its registration number - printed on its label, and the name of its Wi-Fi hotspot - unless it was changed. An X-Hybrid needs none.

fields.label: Register table
fields.help: Leave on Automatic. Type 4 is read with the X1-Boost table; pick the X1-Mini one if the temperature, feed-in and grid import read wrong.
